# A04-S03: Party name

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Here is a video text and a short introduction to our collaboration. I think it could get some time on the screen in the foyer here at the start, where the introduction text is then posted next to it on an A4, and the printout text can lie on the floor/on a small table in front with a clip in the corner. Then one can also read at one’s own pace/normally, if one wants.

How do we do it practically with these things in the future? Should I send to you or [████]?

A bit about the choices I have made: 
I have chosen the party name Det Syntetiske Parti rather than De Virtuelle, because it works better on Google. After corona there is so much about virtuality and virtual party meetings that you simply cannot get through.

Moreover, ‘synthetic’ is a good description of how a language model blends data into a new expression.

I look forward to Julina being ready to step in and lead the party!

Here some instructions for the video:

The video should play at half speed, and be put on loop. It’s very easy on YouTube: You right-click and press 'repeat', and then you set the speed down in settings.

The attached texts can just be printed as they are :-)

I think the next video should have many more images than this one. I am working on making some, but am not quite satisfied yet. But I like this one as a start, because it is so pure AI.
